svg.text: False positives of the sampling-only threshold
Gain from extra effort over the reference design
Sequencing depth at all dates (s = 0.02, p₀ = 0.1)
mean depth at every sampling date

Reference case (museum insect): haplodiploid, Nf = Nm = 1,000 (Ne = 1,500), samples 1935/1955/1975/2025, 20/20/20/40 females, depth 10×/15×, α = 0.05. 1,000 selection simulations per point; SD about 1.5 points.
b, c: breeding numbers varied (Ne shown) with 1×, 2× and 5× the reference sample sizes (line style); p₀ = 0.01, 0.1 and 0.3 with s = 0.05, 0.02 and 0.015, as in d.
d: each option adds 60 individuals or moves the same 100 individuals to the first and last dates; s chosen so that the reference design has 55–67% power; 5,000 selection simulations per point.
e: the same mean depth at every date, minimum depth 1 read; Ne = 1,500 and 100,000; 5,000 selection and 10,000 neutral simulations per point (depth_case.js).
